title: Pinned group in the Add drawer
request: Add a default Pinned group at the top of the Add drawer that users can customize.
decision: How does a user pin an item in the Add drawer without making every tile bigger?

research.question: How do established tools let users pin items in a dense grid?

findings.claim: A small pin icon in the tile corner, outlined when off and filled when on, appears on hover.
Hover-only controls fail on touch, so touch needs a visible fallback.

research.question: Do adaptive most-used menus beat fixed ones?

findings.claim: Adaptive menus are slower than fixed ones (Findlater & McGrenere).

options.title: A pin button beside every tile
options.summary: A full-size sibling button, visible without hover and keyboard reachable.
options.rejectedBecause: it doubles the drawer's height for a secondary action

options.title: A small corner pin icon inside the tile
options.summary: An outline pin in the tile corner on hover and focus, always visible on touch, filled when pinned.

options.title: Pin from a right-click menu
options.summary: A Pin item in the tile's context menu.

options.title: Keep the drawer as it is
options.rejectedBecause: the requester wants quicker access to frequent items

recommendation.reason: Established pattern, no added height, works on touch and keyboard.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: The pin icon is at most 20px square and tile height is unchanged.
On touch the pin is visible without hover; with a keyboard it appears on focus.
The outline icon meets 3:1 against the tile background.
Pinning a tile adds it to the end of the Pinned group.
